Meet the Dev ↓

About • Meet the Dev

From the Streets to the Altar

Art Hoskins — known in the community as Mr. Grind — is a coach, mentor, music producer, mobile mechanic from Long Beach, and the creator of Grind2Give. Happily married for 15 years, father of 7, grandpa of 2, and a proud follower of Jesus.

His life used to be chaotic — from the streets to the altar. That transformation is his story, and it's the story behind his album “From the Streets to the Altar.” Today he works 50 hours a week at his day job, has coached football and basketball for over 20 years, and builds Grind2Give so kids fighting cancer — and communities in need — get real help.

Art tried other crypto projects before G2G. They were meme coins with no real mission, and he'd been rug-pulled too many times as a holder. G2G was built different on purpose: a real mission, automatic giving written into the contract, locked liquidity, and renounced ownership — so no one, not even Art, can change the rules.

Through M2540 Studios (named for Matthew 25:40), Art makes Christian rap, soul, and gospel. His class “Psalms of Greater” had students write praise to God and turn those praises into real songs.

Our Mission

Every Trade Becomes Real Help

What started as a simple desire to give from the heart has grown into a complete movement. While most cryptocurrencies exist only to chase price charts, and most charity coins deliver one-time donations with little transparency, Grind2Give is fundamentally different.

We are not another speculative token. We are not a temporary feel-good project. We are a faith-driven giving movement that turns digital activity into real-world good — automatically, transparently, and perpetually.

Important note: The decision to support a leading pediatric cancer research hospital is made solely by the Grind2Give project. The hospital is not affiliated with, does not endorse, and has no involvement in the $G2G token or this cryptocurrency project. We simply chose to direct the tax proceeds to their work because of the impact they are already making. The recipient hospital treats children with cancer and other life-threatening diseases at no cost to families — your grind helps fund research, treatment, and care so no family ever receives a bill.
